description: Searches the open sales roles (sales and SDR managers, directors and heads of sales, every level of sales. A result carries the title, the employer, the kind of sales role, the posted pay, the location and a link to the role on Sales Legends, where the application starts. No filter is required. Call it when the user wants real openings to read or apply to, a pay floor included (min_pay_usd). For what a kind of sales role pays across the market call get_sales_pay; for counts of open roles by kind or employer call get_sales_market.

country.description: An ISO 3166-1 two-letter country code ('US', 'GB', 'CA' and so on); returns only roles that people in that country can take.

kind.description: One kind of sales role, as one of the slugs listed.

limit.description: How many roles come back, 1 to 25.

min_hourly_usd.description: The floor as an hourly figure, turned into a year at 2,080 hours. Use min_pay_usd unless the user named an hourly rate.

min_pay_usd.description: Returns roles whose posted range tops out at this many US dollars a year or more, for example 250000 for a $250k base or OTE. Pay quoted by the hour is counted at 2,080 hours a year.

platform.description: A single employer, by slug; get_sales_market returns each employer with open roles and the slug to pass here.

query.description: Words matched against role titles, such as 'VP of sales', 'SDR manager', 'EMEA', 'healthcare' or 'renewals'.

name: search_sales_jobs
title: Search sales jobs
